commands.command:
set -eu
HANDOVER=/srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/access.txt
DEMO_USER=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration user:[[:space:]]*//p' "$HANDOVER" | head -1)
DEMO_PASS=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration password:[REDACTED]]]]]*//p' "$HANDOVER" | head -1)
[ -n "$DEMO_USER" ]
[ -n "$DEMO_PASS" ]
NODE2_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node2" {print $1; exit}')
[ -n "$NODE2_IP" ]
if ! grep -q '^RADIUS client secret:[REDACTED]]]\nRADIUS server: %s\nRADIUS client: %s\nRADIUS client secret: [REDACTED]]] "$NODE_IP" "$NODE2_IP" "$CLIENT_SECRET" >> "$HANDOVER"
fi
CLIENT_SECRET=[REDACTED]]] -n 's/^RADIUS client secret:[REDACTED]]]]]*//p' "$HANDOVER" | head -1)
[ -n "$CLIENT_SECRET" ]
cp -a /etc/raddb/clients.conf /etc/raddb/clients.conf.pre-legacy2
sed -i '/^# BEGIN LEGACY2 CLIENT$/,/^# END LEGACY2 CLIENT$/d' /etc/raddb/clients.conf
{
  printf '\n# BEGIN LEGACY2 CLIENT\n'
  printf 'client legacy2-concentrator {\n'
  printf '    ipaddr = %s\n' "$NODE2_IP"
  printf '    secret = [REDACTED]]] "$CLIENT_SECRET"
  printf '    shortname = legacy2\n'
  printf '}\n'
  printf '# END LEGACY2 CLIENT\n'
} >> /etc/raddb/clients.conf
AUTH=/etc/raddb/mods-config/files/authorize
cp -a "$AUTH" "$AUTH.pre-legacy2"
awk -v u="$DEMO_USER" '$1 != u' "$AUTH" > "$AUTH.tmp"
{
  printf '%s Cleartext-Password :[REDACTED]]] "%s"\n' "$DEMO_USER" "$DEMO_PASS"
  cat "$AUTH.tmp"
} > "$AUTH"
rm -f "$AUTH.tmp"
chown root:radiusd /etc/raddb/clients.conf "$AUTH"
chmod 640 /etc/raddb/clients.conf "$AUTH"
chmod 600 "$HANDOVER"
restorecon -F /etc/raddb/clients.conf "$AUTH" "$HANDOVER" 2>/dev/null || true
/usr/sbin/radiusd -XC 2>&1 | tail -25
printf 'configured client=%s user=%s secret_length=[REDACTED]]] "$NODE2_IP" "$DEMO_USER" "$(printf '%s' "$CLIENT_SECRET" | wc -c)"
